Manufacturers Life Insurance Company The Has Upped Thomson Reuters (TRI) Stake; Lyrical Asset Management LP Has Cut Aetna (AET) Stake

Lyrical Asset Management Lp decreased Aetna Inc. (AET) stake by 17.08% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Lyrical Asset Management Lp sold 379,292 shares as Aetna Inc. (AET)’s stock declined 6.45%. The Lyrical Asset Management Lp holds 1.84M shares with $332.23M value, down from 2.22M last quarter. Aetna Inc. now has $58.46 billion valuation. The stock decreased 0.19% or $0.34 $178.71. About 1.92M shares traded. Aetna Inc. (NYSE:AET) has risen 33.34% uptrending. It has outperformed by 21.79% the S&P500.
